privacy.overview.title: Your privacy
privacy.overview.intro: What this store holds about you, which privacy rules apply, and how to act on it — all in one place.
privacy.overview.heldIntro: The categories collected on this storefront, and how long each is kept:
privacy.overview.rulesIntro: The jurisdiction resolved for you decides how consent works here. This is set by the service, not chosen by the page.
privacy.overview.modelOptIn: Opt-in — nothing non-essential runs before you allow it
privacy.overview.modelNotice: Notice and opt-out — you are told what is collected, and a refusal is honoured
privacy.overview.requestsAction: Request a copy, correction or erasure of your data
privacy.overview.unavailableBody: The privacy service did not answer for this page. Nothing is collected behind your back — the consent gate fails closed.
privacy.agent.title: Submit as an authorized agent
privacy.agent.intro: You can submit a privacy request on someone else's behalf if they authorized you in writing. This form records your authorisation — the consumer will still be asked to verify themselves before anything is disclosed.
privacy.agent.kindAccess: Access — see what data is held
privacy.agent.kindExport: Export — download a copy of the data
privacy.agent.kindOptOut: Opt out of sale or sharing
privacy.agent.evidenceWrittenPermission: Written permission signed by the consumer
privacy.agent.evidenceHint: The reference or file id of the scanned authorisation document you submitted.
privacy.agent.statement: The consumer will be asked to verify their identity directly before any data is disclosed or deleted.
privacy.agent.unavailableBody: Agent submissions cannot be recorded right now. Please try again later.
privacy.agent.errorBody: The submission could not be recorded. Check the details and try again.
privacy.choices.title: Your privacy choices
privacy.choices.intro: Every purpose below is a separate decision. Turning one off takes effect immediately, here and on other devices after your next sign-in.
privacy.choices.recordNote: Changes are recorded together with the notice version and your jurisdiction, so your choices can be proven later.
privacy.choices.unavailableBody: The privacy service did not answer, so no preferences can be shown. Nothing non-essential is running while this page is like this.
privacy.choices.gpcNote: A browser privacy signal (Global Privacy Control) was detected and applied. It holds the affected purposes down until you explicitly override it below.
privacy.choices.lockedNote: Held by your browser privacy signal.
privacy.choices.overrideBody: Your browser asked us not to sell or share your information. Overriding replaces that signal with your own explicit choice.
privacy.erasure.title: Erasing your data
privacy.erasure.intro: Erasure removes your personal data from this storefront. It is a real request with real consequences, so this page explains what happens before you confirm.
privacy.erasure.willBeDeletedBody: Your profile, contact details, preferences, consents and non-transactional history are erased or anonymised so they can no longer be linked to you.
privacy.erasure.retainedBody: Some records are retained because the law requires it — invoices for tax, for example, or records of consent so we can prove what you chose. Everything below is kept only for the listed period.
privacy.erasure.coolingBody: After you submit, a short cooling-off window opens. You can cancel from your request status page during it; after it closes, deletion runs and cannot be undone.
privacy.erasure.breaksBody: Orders can no longer be traced to you, saved preferences disappear, and an account with this email cannot be recovered afterwards. Sign-in with this account stops working.
privacy.erasure.successBody: Check the request status page for its progress and the cooling-off window.
privacy.erasure.unavailableBody: Erasure cannot be submitted right now. Nothing is deleted by a failed request.
privacy.erasure.errorBody: The request could not be submitted. Check the details and try again.
privacy.optOut.title: Do Not Sell or Share My Personal Information
privacy.optOut.intro: Press once to stop the sale or sharing of your personal information and to opt out of targeted advertising and profiling. You do not need an account, and no verification is required.
privacy.optOut.doneBody: Your opt-out is recorded and takes effect at the source, not just on this screen. Processing covered by the opt-out stops for this browser immediately and stays stopped.
privacy.optOut.effectiveDays: Opt-outs on this storefront take effect within {count} business days.
privacy.optOut.alreadyBody: This browser already has an opt-out (your choice or a browser privacy signal). Nothing more to do — but pressing again changes nothing.
privacy.optOut.unavailableBody: The opt-out service did not answer. Nothing is being shared while it is down.
privacy.optOut.errorBody: The opt-out could not be recorded. Please try again in a moment.
privacy.limitSensitive.title: Limit the Use of My Sensitive Personal Information
privacy.limitSensitive.intro: Press once to limit how your sensitive personal information is used. You do not need an account, and no verification is required.
privacy.limitSensitive.doneBody: Sensitive personal information is now limited to what the service strictly requires — you will not see this change, but the restriction is enforced at the source.
privacy.limitSensitive.unavailableBody: The privacy service did not answer. Nothing beyond the service requirements happens with sensitive data while it is down.
privacy.limitSensitive.errorBody: The limitation could not be recorded. Please try again in a moment.
privacy.requests.title: Your privacy requests
privacy.requests.intro: Ask for a copy, a correction or the erasure of your data. The deadline shown comes from the rules that apply to your jurisdiction, not from us.
privacy.requests.kindAccess: Access — see what data we hold about you
privacy.requests.kindExport: Export — download a copy of your data
privacy.requests.kindErasure: Erasure — delete my data (see the erasure page first)
privacy.requests.emailHint: We send a one-time code to this address to verify it is you.
privacy.requests.verifyBody: We sent a one-time code to {email}. Enter it below to confirm the request.
privacy.requests.trackIntro: The request id is in the confirmation email. The token comes with the download link, if your request has one.
privacy.requests.errorBody: The request could not be submitted. Check the details and try again.
privacy.requests.verifyErrorBody: That code was not accepted. Check the email and try again.
privacy.requestDetail.title: Request status
privacy.requestDetail.notFoundBody: This request does not exist, or the token is wrong. Check the link from the confirmation email.
privacy.requestDetail.downloadBody: The download link is single-use and expires. The passphrase is NOT in this email chain — it was delivered separately. Keep both at hand before you start.
privacy.requestDetail.downloadNoToken: The download link and its token were sent to you separately from the passphrase. Open that link to download; it works once.
privacy.appeal.title: Appeal this decision
privacy.appeal.intro: If your privacy request was refused, you can appeal. A different reviewer who did not make the original decision will look at it again.
privacy.appeal.reasonLabel: Why do you think the refusal was wrong?
privacy.appeal.authorityTitle: You can also complain to the authority
privacy.appeal.authorityIntro: Independent of your appeal, you can raise this with the authority responsible for your jurisdiction:
privacy.appeal.errorBody: The appeal could not be submitted. Check the details and try again.
